svg.title: 多性质条件 VAE：从目标性质逆向生成新化学式
svg.desc: The deployed conditional VAE samples new composition fractions from sparse material-property targets and a random latent variable. Database retrieval is not part of generation.

text.tspan: 多性质条件 VAE：从目标性质逆向生成新化学式
Property targets → sparse condition vector → stochastic decoding → chemically filtered formula proposals
A 智能体输入：稀疏多性质目标
B 条件 VAE：训练与生成路径
C 新化学式候选与后续验证
